verdict.rationale: Steel's own docs include a cookbook recipe to "Expose a Steel browser to any MCP client" and a Claude Agent SDK integration that exposes the cloud browser as in-process MCP tools. This is first-party MCP support, but the evidence shows a recipe and an SDK-embedded integration rather than a clearly packaged, maintained official MCP server or hosted endpoint. missing for 10: a documented standalone official MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint, a tool list and setup details for generic MCP clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.
